title: The Canteen Ran Out Of Samosas… WAR 🤖 Ep.1

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 12:30 p.m. Choto Mia's canteen. [beat] One announcement… and this school lost its mind.

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: Listen, listen! Samosas… FINISHED! [beat] Only bread and despair left!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: FINISHED?! [beat] Bro, I queued through MATH class for this!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: This is what they wanted. Starve us… so we can't think. [beat] I read about this.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Just a SAMOSA? [beat] Mira, I'd trade my ranked account for one right now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then… the doors burst open. Jamal Chacha. Back from Dubai. [beat] With a steel tiffin carrier.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Beta! In Dubai, we never say finished! [beat] Fifty samosas. Home delivery. Your uncle's treat!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: FIFTY samosas?! [beat] Who told him to cook? I MUST call everyone. EVERYONE.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Step aside, step aside… [beat] bully privilege. I queued first, remember?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Bruno. [beat] The back of the line has excellent… education.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The line reorganized itself… [beat] with record speed.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Best day of my life. [beat] Follow for part two — someone HID a whole secret stash in the staff room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The staff room stash… [beat] was about to become this school's biggest scandal.
